title: Coach Beard - Leghe Fantacalcio Export Contract
description: Contratto dati e istruzioni per generare il CSV di importazione rose compatibile con Leghe Fantacalcio tramite il formato ufficiale FantaAsta Live.

name.description: Il nome non può contenere virgole, dollari o ritorni a capo perché il parser ufficiale divide ogni riga con una semplice virgola.

officialPlayerId.description: ID numerico del calciatore presente nel listone ufficiale Fantacalcio. È il valore esportato nel CSV.

playerName.description: Usato per interfaccia, verifiche e audit. Non viene scritto nel CSV Leghe.

x-officialExportFormat.exampleCsv:
$,$,$
Atletico Ma Non Troppo,1234,28
Atletico Ma Non Troppo,5678,1
$,$,$
Real Colizzati,9012,47
Real Colizzati,3456,15

x-transformationAlgorithm: Validate the complete input against this JSON Schema.
Run all cross-record validations listed in x-businessValidation before serialization.
For each team, append exactly one marker row containing three dollar signs: $,$,$.
Select only players whose status is purchased.
Sort players deterministically by role order P,D,C,A and then by playerName using the Italian locale.
For each selected player append: team name, official numeric player ID, purchase price.
Join columns with a literal comma and rows with LF. Do not add a header row.
Append one final LF at end of file.
Return the CSV as UTF-8 text without BOM.
Never use an LLM to calculate, validate or serialize this export.

blockingRules: Every displayOrder must be unique and cover the integers from 1 to 8.
Every team name must be unique and must not contain comma, dollar sign, CR or LF.
Every final roster must contain exactly 25 purchased players.
Every final roster must contain exactly 3 P, 8 D, 8 C and 6 A.
Every officialPlayerId must be unique across the entire league.
Every officialPlayerId must exist in the datasetVersion locked to the auction session.
Every purchasePrice must be a positive integer.
The sum of purchasePrice for each team must be less than or equal to 1000.
The computed remaining credits must equal 1000 minus the sum of purchase prices.
Do not export nominated, unsold, released, deleted or compensated purchases.

x-cursorImplementationTask.objective: Implementare l'export deterministico delle rose di Coach Beard nel formato CSV accettato da Leghe Fantacalcio.

requiredFunctions.behavior: Valida schema JSON e regole cross-record senza modificare l'input.
Restituisce esattamente il CSV descritto in x-officialExportFormat o solleva un errore tipizzato se la validazione fallisce.
Genera un nome file sicuro secondo filenamePattern.

implementationConstraints: Keep serializer and validators in the domain/export module, independent from Next.js and database code.
Use integer arithmetic only for credits and prices.
Do not silently repair malformed team names or unknown player IDs.
Do not quote team names containing commas: reject them because the official importer uses simple comma splitting.
Do not expose database IDs in place of officialPlayerId.
The download route must require the authenticated allowlisted owner.
The export must be reproducible: identical logical input produces identical CSV bytes.
requiredTests: Golden-file test comparing the generated CSV byte-for-byte with expected output.
Reject a league with 7 or 9 teams.
Reject duplicate officialPlayerId values across different teams.
Reject a team name containing a comma, dollar sign or newline.
Reject a roster with incorrect role counts.
Reject a team that spends more than 1000 credits.
Reject a player ID absent from the locked dataset version.
Verify marker row before every team block.
Verify absence of header and BOM.
Verify deterministic team and player ordering.
Verify one final LF and no additional blank rows.
Verify that compensated or released acquisitions are excluded.
definitionOfDone: A CSV generated from a completed simulated auction can be uploaded from Admin > Gestione Rose > Importa rose.
The Leghe interface recognizes all 8 roster blocks and allows each roster to be associated with the corresponding league team.
Player IDs and purchase prices shown in the import preview match Coach Beard exactly.
